target_definition: bits/byte at 1B parameters (100 tokens/parameter, DataDecide ladder), equal-weight average over the 11 DataDecide eval sets (all11) or the 4 sets no recipe trains on (ood4)

unigram_ce.source: Chung & Kim 2026 (word overlap predicts performance): lower corpus->eval unigram cross-entropy forecasts better performance; add-0.5 smoothing

dolma.note: Dolma v1.7 (files on olmo-data.org, list on HF)

redpajama_1t.note: RedPajama-Data-1T-Sample (1B-token random sample of RedPajama-1T; official repo no longer served)

fineweb.note: parent corpus of DataDecide's FineWeb-Edu and FineWeb-Pro

row_labels.mismatch: PRIMARY. ours_mismatch of datadecide_predict.py: affine in the eval-set mismatch M (bigram cross-entropy of the DataDecide eval text under the corpus sample minus the eval text's own), fitted on the 25 recipes. No reference LM.
row_labels.ref_gpt2-2019_only: reference-LM row with GPT-2 only (WebText, 2019; predates every corpus ranked here)
row_labels.ref_gpt2_only: reference-LM row with GPT-2 only (WebText, 2019; predates every corpus ranked here)
row_labels.ref_SmolLM2-135M_only: SECONDARY, possibly contaminated: SmolLM2-135M was pretrained on FineWeb-Edu and DCLM
row_labels.ref_pythia-160m_only: not used for ranking: Pythia was trained on the Pile, which is ranked here
row_labels.ref_lm: possibly contaminated: pool includes SmolLM2 (FineWeb-Edu, DCLM) and Pythia (Pile) statistics
